verification.reason: EvidenceStore.write (pipeline/src/evidence.ts:229-239, place at 338-357) rethrows raw fs errors (ENOSPC/EACCES from mkdir/open/writeFile/sync) without wrapping them in EvidenceError. CloneEvidence.keep catches only EvidenceError (evidence.ts:61-62) and rethrows everything else. The adjudication was committed earlier in adjudicateComparison (compare.ts:249). So the CLI exits with a raw error and no "adjudication is recorded, but no evidence was kept" message, unlike the budget/link refusals. The same gap exists for MissEvidence.gather, which sits outside the try. The impact is narrower than the claim states: compare.ts:254 prints "Adjudicated <id> as valid by ..." to stdout before keep runs, so the user does see that the verdict was recorded. What is missing is the clear note that only the evidence copy failed.
